hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [[ "$f" =~ \.(js|jsx|ts|tsx|mjs)$ ]] && npx eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null; [[ "$f" =~ \.(js|jsx|ts|tsx|mjs|css|md|json)$ ]] && npx prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null; } || true

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '^git (add|commit|restore|clean|pull|merge|rebase|stash)( |$)|^git reset.*--hard|^git checkout( --| \.)|^git push.*(-f |--force)|^git branch.*(-d|-D)|^git tag'; then echo '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "Blocked by project policy: dangerous git command. Run git operations manually in the terminal."}'; exit 1; fi
